topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I'm standing here, fingers trembling as I clutch the edges of my old, faded teddy bear. His glass eyes seem to be staring back, absorbing the time that's slipped between then and now. I can feel the weight of the decades in his soft, worn fur. The scent of attics and forgotten corners drifts up, mingling with the fresh, crisp air of the yard sale. My hands are clammy, and I glance around to see if anyone's noticed my reaction. I should put him back, shouldn't I? But the thought of walking away, of leaving him here, in a stranger's yard, feels almost unbearable.
